get.summary: Read internal products and workflow states
x-invariants: publicationState DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW or PUBLISHED selects products by the corresponding currentDraftRevisionId, pendingRevisionId or publishedRevisionId pointer. ARCHIVED matches the root CatalogProduct.publicationState. With DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW or PUBLISHED, categoryId must match the category on that same pointer-selected revision. Without publicationState, categoryId matches any existing current draft, pending or published pointer. The ARCHIVED + categoryId combination is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR because product archival clears all current pointers. Non-current historical revisions never satisfy this filter.

x-invariants: Requires expectedVersion and baseRevisionId. With a current DRAFT, baseRevisionId must equal currentDraftRevisionId and the prior DRAFT becomes SUPERSEDED. Without a draft or pending revision, baseRevisionId must equal the latest RETURNED/REJECTED revision created after the current published revision; if none exists it must equal the current published revision. An unpublished product may use its latest RETURNED/REJECTED revision. The command appends a new immutable DRAFT copied from that base. A pending review blocks draft creation. Published pointer is unchanged.

Before first successful submit, the effective identity tuple (brandId, manufacturerName, originalPartNumber, modification) is written to the root and new DRAFT snapshot in the same transaction; omitted identity fields inherit from baseRevisionId. Existing SUPERSEDED snapshots remain unchanged. After first submit the root tuple is frozen and every subsequent revision copies it exactly; attempted changes fail with INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION. Root identity uniqueness conflict is IDENTITY_CONFLICT and rolls back revision and audit.

post.summary: Archive product and withdraw pending revision
x-invariants: ARCHIVE is terminal from any non-archived root state. In one transaction it withdraws a pending revision as WITHDRAWN, clears publishedRevisionId, pendingRevisionId and currentDraftRevisionId, sets publicationState=ARCHIVED, revokes public visibility and writes audit. It preserves all product revisions and FileVersion references; it deletes no data.

get.summary: List a bounded page of active direct child categories
get.x-cache-policy: Public data only; implementations must not serve draft or archived data.
x-invariants: Return only ACTIVE direct children of parentSlug; when parentSlug is absent, return ACTIVE root categories.
An unknown or inactive parentSlug returns the same 404 response.
Order each page by sortOrder ASC then slug ASC; use an optional keyset cursor and pageSize 1..100 (default 24), with no page-number ceiling.
The opaque unpadded base64url cursor encodes the last returned nonnegative int32 sortOrder and canonical slug separated by a colon; reject malformed cursors.
Each response contains one level only and at most pageSize categories; meta.nextCursor is null at the end. Clients assemble navigation trees with additional bounded requests.

get.summary: Search and filter published catalog products

parameters.name: includeDescendants
parameters.description: Include products assigned to active descendant categories.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive substring over published display name, brand, manufacturer, original part number, modification and searchable attribute snapshots. No regex or ranking. An empty string is treated as absent.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Repeatable decoded grammar attributeCode:operator:value; categorySlug is required. Supported ops: eq all types, contains TEXT, gte/lte DECIMAL or INTEGER. Filters are ANDed; duplicate code/operator is invalid.

CategoryIdQuery.name: categoryId
CategoryIdQuery.description: Staff product list filter. With DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW or PUBLISHED, this category must belong to that same pointer-selected revision. Without publicationState, it matches any current draft, pending or published revision pointer. Combining categoryId with ARCHIVED is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR because product archival clears all current pointers; historical non-current revisions are ignored.

ProductState.name: publicationState
ProductState.description: Staff product list filter. DRAFT, PENDING_REVIEW and PUBLISHED select the corresponding current revision pointer; ARCHIVED matches root CatalogProduct.publicationState.
